summary: [probe] The undated phrase list matches plain behavior: '예약자가 회의에서 나가면 알림이 멈춘다.' (회의에서), 'Expenses approved by a manager are paid on the next run.' (approved by), 'The page shows the reviewer's decision on the request.' (decision on), 'If the invitee decided to leave, the slot frees up.' (decided to). 회의에서 is the phrase round 1 #3 removed as 'in the meeting'; the corpus now pins '회의에서 유지한다.' as a hit. Meeting, booking and approval-workflow briefs draw these on behavior, and the only remedy is the section waiver above.
